## Primary service areas
Burlington, Oakville, Milton, Halton Hills, Halton Region, Mississauga, Toronto, Greater Toronto Area (GTA), Vaughan, Hamilton, Pickering, Ajax, Whitby, Oshawa, Durham Region, Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge, and Waterloo Region.

## Specialization
Ritesh Batra's positioning is decision-first, data-driven real estate guidance without sales pressure. His approach is to compare price, carrying costs, neighbourhood fit, property condition, resale implications, negotiation risk and alternatives before a client commits.
